scope: Diary prose before Freewrite horizontal rule, outside multi-column cards, without astrbot identity comments

implementation.placement: Freewrite ends at its first standalone horizontal rule outside code fences; body ends with exactly one blank line before the rule
implementation.identity: Private local receipts hold record revisions, owned paragraph locations, snapshots and file hashes; Markdown has no generated astrbot comments
implementation.recovery: Persist confirmed pending batch before file replacement; reconcile actual before/after hashes after interruption, including partial cross-day moves
implementation.manual_edits: Preserve unrelated edits; reject changed or ambiguous owned prose rather than guessing
implementation.other_sections: Keep handwritten text, highlight, column settings, Habit/Learning and footer bytes

coverage: Realistic YAML, task and Freewrite separators, highlight callout and column-settings layout
Migration of legacy paragraphs out of cards and removal of identity comments
Exact blank line before horizontal rule
Duplicate record text shares one paragraph and remains until last source withdrawn
A paragraph that is a prefix of another retains independent ownership
Receipt loss and all-files-written recovery do not duplicate prose
Both partial cross-day interruption orders recover correctly
Manual prose edits stop replacement, unrelated handwriting is preserved
Untracked greeting/sleep fragments do not rebuild current prose

visual_acceptance: Verified exact Markdown structure against the actual daily template; owner can review rendered Obsidian appearance
